items.title: SK Hynix Q3 profit jumps sevenfold to record high, Nvidia supplier unveils $75 billion shareholder return plan
items.author: Reuters
items.highlights: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix reported a more than seven-fold rise in quarterly operating profit to a record high on Wednesday, beating market forecasts, as continued demand for AI infrastructure drove up memory chip prices. The Nvidia supplier also said it will pursue shareholder returns totalling about 100 trillion won ($75.4 billion) this year, comprising cash dividends of 30 trillion won and share repurchases and cancellations of 60 trillion won, including 40 trillion won announced in August. SK Hynix also reiterated that it expects demand to continue to exceed supply through 2030.

items.title: SK hynix Earnings: Memory Maker's Operating Margin Now Tops Nvidia's
items.author: Stock Titan Editorial Team
items.highlights: The short answer. SK hynix reported record sales of 104.6 trillion won for July to September 2026. Its operating margin, operating profit as a share of sales, was 79.7%, which it rounds to 80%, against 66.2% for Nvidia in its latest quarter, by our calculation. Even if you own no shares, it matters because SK hynix expects the rising cost of memory to mean fewer PCs and phones shipped. Net profit, what is left after every gain, loss and tax, was less than half of operating profit, cut by a currency loss and an investment loss. ...
